concerns.text: Task T044 mandates 'fail loudly' and raise an exception on LLM failure, directly contradicting spec FR-006 and Plan Principle VI which require a fallback to template-based explanations to prevent pipeline crashes. This task silently relaxes the availability constraint of the counterfactual generator.

Task T013d implements a 'Soft Fail' strategy (proceeding with 0 environments) which violates spec FR-001 and User Story 1's explicit requirement to extend '16 existing EvoPolicyGym environments'. The task allows the deliverable to fall short of the FR scope without a blocking error.

Task T021b describes a fallback logic that 'attempts a fallback to a smaller model' if the primary fails. This introduces unbounded latency risk (primary timeout + secondary load + inference) violating the strict 30s threshold defined in Plan 'Performance Goals' and Spec Edge Cases.

Task T038 aggregates counts from logs to infer success rates but fails to explicitly capture 'successful generations' as a distinct metric. This risks violating SC-004's requirement to measure the rate of successful generation against total failures, as it cannot distinguish LLM failures from other pipeline errors (e.g., syntax errors).
